title: Kitchen Smoked Brazilian Lime Skewers
description: A savory and shattering Brazilian dish featuring unwaxed lime, this lacto-vegetarian friendly recipe is a quick fix for any meal, with a unique smoke-cold flavor profile that is sure to delight.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together smoked paprika, garlic, olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lime wedges to the bowl and toss to coat with the smoked paprika mixture.
Thread a lime wedge onto each skewer, leaving a small space between each wedge.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the skewers in the preheated oven for 10 minutes, or until the limes are slightly caramelized.
Remove the skewers from the oven and let cool to room temperature.
Sprinkle the chopped cilantro over the skewers and serve immediately.
